updates.title: A true mobile app feel
updates.notes: LegalBill Mobile now looks and works like a native phone app: a clean 5-button bottom bar (Home, Clients, Matters, Fee notes and More) replaces the long scrolling tab strip - everything else lives in a tidy More sheet. Forms slide up as full-width sheets with a drag handle, buttons and inputs are bigger and easier to tap, and the app bar stays neatly at the top as you scroll.

updates.title: Mobile catches up to desktop - licensing, two offices, tax module
updates.notes: LegalBill Mobile now matches the desktop app: server-verified licence and 7-day free trial, separate Attorneys and Advocates offices, the SA tax & compliance module (VAT, IRP6, compliance calendar), searchable court pickers, counsel billing, collapsible sections and the premium document designs. Update from inside the app or download the new APK.

updates.title: Fixes “Supabase cloud SDK could not be loaded” sign-in error
updates.notes: If the bundled Supabase library fails to load on a device (which was blocking sign-in on some phones with 'Supabase cloud SDK: could not be loaded'), the app now automatically fetches it from the internet so you can sign in. Also refreshes the bundled library to the official 2.108.2 build and, if it ever still fails, shows the exact error instead of a generic message. No data or feature changes. Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
